reconciliation.duplicationMechanism: Prior to this closure pass, routedCompletion() logged internally via logAIInteraction() (awaited/durable whenever feature==='curriculum' && provenanceWritersEnabled(), which is true on staging) AND scripts/p2c-live-ai-sme-proof.ts called logAIInteraction() a second time itself (also durable: true) using the same generationCorrelationId, as a defensive measure against routedCompletion's internal write being fire-and-forget outside that condition. Both calls unconditionally created a new row with no dedup guard, so every real invocation across all 3 runs was persisted twice in AIInteraction and, since the second call always followed the first, twice in AiInteractionLog too. Fixed: logAIInteraction() (lib/ai/interactionLog.ts) now looks up an existing AIInteraction row by generationCorrelationId before creating one, and only writes the legacy AiInteractionLog row when it is actually creating a new canonical AIInteraction row -- see the dedup describe block in __tests__/ai.interactionLog.test.ts and the live post-fix telemetry proof in docs/ops/P2C_AI_TELEMETRY_RECONCILIATION.json.
